title: Renew a paintball venue permit
summary: This page provides information on how to renew an expiring paintball venue permit.
intro:
When your current paintball venue permit is nearing expiry, you’ll receive an email prompting you to renew.

You must submit your renewal application before your permit expires.
what_you_need: The PDF form: 'Application for a paintball venue permit'
The PDF form: 'Paintball permit additional details form' (if applicable)
Your business details, including names of any directors, body corporate, partnership or sole trader
The address of each paintball venue

how_to_steps.text: Submit your payment online and enter the receipt number on the application form.
Download and complete the Paintball permit additional details form – PDF if applicable.
Email the form and supporting documents using the details on the form, or visit a Service NSW Centre to submit in person.

more_info.text: If you have a permit from NSW Police, that was current at 1 July 2019, you have an extra 12 months from your expiry to renew.
The same fee applies for a 1, 3 or 5-year permit.
The fee is for each paintball venue.
If your licence expired within 3 months of the expiry date, you can restore your licence.
If your licence expired more than 3 months after the expiry date you'll need to apply for a new licence.
You can contact Fair Trading to find out your expiry date.
